tonight.headline: Zvada kicked 2 — and Gordon still sits behind Marks
body: Bad news first: Dominic Zvada, the kicker you added for Matt Gay on Thursday morning, scored 2.0 Thursday night (archive); Gay plays Sunday against Seattle. Ollie Gordon (15.7) is still on your bench behind Woody Marks (14.0) at FLEX — for the third brief running. Marks is healthy now (full Friday, off the report), but David Montgomery practised fully and is questionable, which cuts Marks back to a FLEX-level role if he plays (NBC 13 Nov 20:58Z). This morning you dropped Colston Loveland for Rome Odunze; both are Bears, on bye.

Daniels 20.3, Likely 27.7 and Zvada 2.0 are banked: 49.96 to 0 against the 9-0 Maye-day. ESPN: 138.0 to 128.9, 55%. One free move before Sunday 12:00 CDMX: Gordon into the FLEX, Marks to the bench. No Sunday checks — no projected starter is in doubt.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day start Alvin Kamara (10.3), and Travis Etienne — full Friday, activation due Saturday (Athlon 13 Nov) — may take carries from the Saints' committee. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (22.4) and Brock Bowers (15.5) carry their projection; Patrick Mahomes sits on their bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gordon left on the bench and Marks held to a FLEX share by Montgomery: the 1.7 the projection sees, in a game ESPN calls 55-45.

doFirst.title: Start Gordon at FLEX, bench Marks
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's FLEX by 1.7 — a coin flip, so it goes to the projection with no thesis.

case.label: The call
case.body: Gordon 15.7, Marks 14.0 (lineup_check.py: COIN FLIP — take the projection). No decision-log entry: coin flips get none.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: Thursday's reason for urgency is gone — Marks practised fully Friday and is off the report. But Montgomery also practised fully and is questionable; if both play, Marks 'would likely drop back to a FLEX option' (NBC 13 Nov 20:58Z). The news still points the same way as the projection.

case.label: Gordon's week
case.body: 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9 (archive) with Achane on IR; Kyle McCord's first start (Hafley via Yahoo 13 Nov). Jaylen Wright was full all week — the one threat to the share.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Marks outscores Gordon in Week 10 (archive). Graded on the outcome, not written to the log.

whatWentWrong.title: The Gordon swap has waited three briefs
whatWentWrong.lead: Recommended Wednesday, repeated Thursday, still not made at 22:05Z Friday.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Thursday's brief made it the one move left; the snapshot still has Marks in slot 23 and Gordon on the bench.

case.label: Why it still matters
case.body: 1.7 projected points is small, but it is free and it is the only lineup gap in either league this week. STRATEGY §0: every early loss was winnable with the roster already owned.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Montgomery ruled inactive Sunday morning — Marks' share would return to 100%, but the projection call is set by then and stays.

roster.footnote: Washington at New York is final (Daniels 20.3, Likely 27.7, Zvada 2.0); every other game is Sunday or later. Matchup tiles: PFN points allowed by position, PPR, through Week 9 — Great means a soft defence. Kicker, D/ST, Jacobs (out) and Odunze (bye) not graded.

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 1.7 below the projection lineup: Gordon over Marks at FLEX, a COIN FLIP taken by the projection with no thesis.
